name: llm-prefill-decode-visualizer
description: LLM inference performance math: TTFT, TPOT, walltime for single-turn chat, agentic loops, batched serving, speculative decoding, and KV-cache VRAM. Includes community-measured hardware benchmarks.

endpoints.description: Full OpenAPI 3.1 spec — derive all endpoints from this.

Run inference math. ?model=singleTurn|speculative|batched|agentic|kvCache plus parameters. No model param returns a self-describing capability list. Batching: POST {"batch": [up to 50 parameter sets]} returns per-index results with per-item ok/error status.
Built-in hardware speed presets (RTX 4090, dual RTX 3090, M3 Ultra, Groq LPU, H100, RPi5) and workload scenarios (RAG, code generation). Feed these into /api/compute.
Community-measured single-stream benchmark runs with normalized model families. No params = hardware summary; ?hardware=&model=&quant=&limit=N filters.

Full run-index dump in one response: every community-measured run (comparable and non-comparable), each row tagged `comparable`. ?comparable=true|false pre-filters; ?format=csv returns RFC 4180 CSV with a #-comment data dictionary. Best for one-shot crawls — no pagination.
Aggregated median + IQR speeds per hardware×model group (outlier-resistant). ?groupBy=hardware|model|quant.
Ranked answers: ?by=decode&maxParamsB=8&quant=q4_k_m → top rigs for ≤8B models at Q4_K_M.

One-call hardware sizing recommendation: pass a workload spec (?model=<family>&contextLength=&concurrency=&maxTtftSeconds=&maxTpotMs=&maxVramGb=) and get ranked rigs with required-VRAM math, expected TTFT/TPOT from benchmark medians, sample confidence, and meetsSlo flags.
Versioned dataset snapshot IDs. All data endpoints accept ?snapshot=<id> (and return a snapshot object) for reproducible, citable results.
